name: Causeway Coast Way
description_md:
The Causeway Coast Way is a waymarked hiking route in IE that spans 49.6 km. This regional waymarked hiking network trail requires about 15 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule to complete.

The route features 860 m of ascent and 876 m of descent. It is classified as hard due to the distance and ascent involved. The path passes Portrush within 100 m and the Giant's Causeway within 200 m.
